channel.description: Latest articles from The Denver Post (denverpost.com)

item.title: Skier killed in avalanche near Copper Mountain
item.description: Rescue crews found a missing skier's body in avalanche debris near Copper Mountain early Sunday morning, state officials said.

item.title: Colorado gains postseason confidence from battle against No. 2 Arizona
item.description: When the upset bid fell short, it left the Colorado men’s basketball team with a 7-11 league mark in the second season back in the Big 12.

item.title: Danny Scudero ‘blessed’ to join CU Buffs, add to talented receiving corps
item.description: In choosing to transfer to Colorado this past winter, Danny Scudero knew he might have to take on a slightly lesser role.

item.title: CSU football gets off to ‘pretty average’ start, Mora says
item.description: The Rams were enthusiastic and full of energy on the first day of practice

item.title: Avalanche best Wild in shootout, sweep division rivals in huge weekend
item.description: The Colorado Avalanche picked a great weekend to figure things out in the shootout.

item.title: Nearly 100 evacuated from Centennial hotel for fire
item.description: Nearly 100 people staying at a Centennial hotel were evacuated Sunday afternoon after a fire sparked in one of the rooms, according to South Metro Fire Rescue.

item.title: Broncos retain TE Adam Trautman with three-year deal on eve of free agency, sources say
item.description: Denver reached out to Trautman on Sunday afternoon and an agreement got hammered out in a matter of hours.

item.title: Keeler: Avalanche hero Nazem Kadri just made Nathan MacKinnon smile like it’s 2022 all over again
item.description: You've heard of fans who can't wait to drive a player to the airport, right? Avalanche faithful apparently tried to get Nazem Kadri from DIA back to Ball Arena quicker after his plane landed late Saturday night.

item.title: Broncos, QB Sam Ehlinger agree to one-year, $2 million deal, source says
item.description: The Broncos and QB Sam Ehlinger agreed to terms on a one-year, $2 million deal that will keep the quarterback in Denver and out of free agency, a source told The Post on Sunday night.
